notes:
Scope: This feed covers the V1 "La Verde" trolleybus/BRT line (Pescara Piazza della Repubblica / Terminal Filobus <-> Montesilvano Pala Dean Martin), which is the highest-ridership, best-documented mode of the TUA Urbano Pescara network and was prioritised per the metro/BRT-first directive.

Sources used:
- Stops + ordering + WGS-84 coordinates: OpenStreetMap trolleybus route master relation 18770798 and its two direction relations 18770796 (Pescara->Montesilvano, from=Pescara Centrale-Piazza della Repubblica, to=Montesilvano Centro Congressi, ref=V1, route=trolleybus) and 18770797 (return). Fetched via api.openstreetmap.org/api/0.6/relation/{id}/full.json. OSM platform members are not stored in travel order, so stops were re-ordered geographically along the monotonic SE->NW corridor (Pescara lat 42.470 -> Montesilvano lat 42.523). Direction 0 = 23 stops, direction 1 = 25 stops (return uses the Portogallo/Foscolo one-way loop and adds Cadorna); 28 unique stops total.
- Schedule: official TUA analytical PDF (tuabruzzo.it/uploads/model_25/.files/50_item_2.pdf), extracted with pdftotext. Confirmed day-types and exact departure times: LUN-GIO (Mon-Thu) every ~10 min, first dep 06:00 both termini; VENERDI (Fri) same days + night extension to 00:30 (Pescara) / 01:00 (Montesilvano); SABATO (Sat) every 15 min with night extension; FESTIVO (Sun/holiday) every 15 min, 07:00 -> ~22:00/22:30. Journey time ~30 min end to end. PDF note: trips departing Pescara do NOT serve C.so Vittorio Emanuele II (Bar Lucio) and Via Silvio Pellico.

Confidence rationale (0.72): Stop names, ordering and coordinates are OSM WGS-84 and reliable. Day-types, first/last departures, headways and route narrative are from the official TUA PDF and cross-checked against ilpescara.it and Wikipedia. Intermediate stop_times are INTERPOLATED evenly across the documented ~30-min run time (the PDF gives terminal departure times only, no per-stop timepoints), and one representative trip per direction per day-type is emitted rather than the full every-10-min block. Coordinates for the two directions' shared stops were taken from whichever direction's node was encountered first (sub-meter differences).

Route_type note: V1 is a trolleybus, which is GTFS extended route_type 11; the core GTFS value 3 (bus) is used here for compatibility. It operates as a BRT with reserved lane for ~75% of its 8.15 km length.

Not built: the other Urbano Pescara bus lines (R, 2/, 3, 4, 4/, 5, 6, 6/, 7, 9S, 10-16, 21, 38, 45). Their TUA analytical PDFs give terminal departure times and street-level route narratives but NO geocoded ordered intermediate stop lists, and no OSM route relations with platform nodes were available for them, so building them would require inventing stops (disallowed). Only V1 had evidence sufficient for faithful stops.

calendar_dates: The Fri/Sat night extensions and the exact holiday calendar are documented in prose but not encoded as separate trips beyond the day-type representative trips; a production feed should expand each service into its full headway block and add calendar_dates for Italian public holidays (treated as FESTIVO).
